newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 14.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Biscuit-maker Arnotts Ltd was forced to ask supermarkets in Queensland and New South Wales to remove their entire product range from their shelves on Friday after an extortionist threatened to poison their biscuits if a police murder case was not re-opened by February 17.

Metals miner Pasminco Ltd said on Friday that the failure of talks between RTZ-CRA and aborigines over the Century zinc mine did not threaten Pasminco's plans to eventually buy the project for A$345 million. RTZ-CRA said early on Friday that talks with aboriginal groups over development of the massive Century zinc mine in the state of Queensland collapsed overnight.

Hudson Conway Ltd said on Thursday that it and Lend Lease Corp Ltd would bid jointly for both Melbourne's proposed Docklands Stadium and the overall A$2 billion Melbourne Docklands redevelopment. Leighton's Thiess Contractors unit is also part of another bid for the project.

Rural Press Ltd said on Thursday that trading for the first five weeks of the second half of the 1996/97 year had been slightly below last year. Rural Press said that its history of profit growth would continue as long as economy improved.

John Fairfax and Coca Cola are expected to report their first half and annual results respectively. Analysts expected Fairfax to post a net profit before abnormals of between A$37 million to A$42 million, down from A$62.43 million in the a half a year earlier. Analysts expect Coca Cola to report a net profit before abnormals for the year of A$138 million to A$146 million, falt on the A$138.6 million recorded in 1995.
